acceptance.given: A repository-relative replay matrix declares the closed required semantic case set and its case fixtures before execution.

oracle.expected: The replay-matrix execution returns a successful aggregate only when its executed case results contain exactly one case for each required semantic distinction: valid package, invalid package, historical compatibility, dirty baseline, knowledge read-set collision, and closed-policy architecture-index gap.
forbidden: Any required semantic distinction is absent.
A case outside the closed set replaces a required semantic distinction.
A duplicate or relabeled case is counted as coverage for a missing required distinction.
oracle.observable: The replay receipt's executed case results and the matrix fixture together identify exactly the six required semantic distinctions, with one executed result for each.

acceptance.then: The closed Matrix Case set has been completely exercised with one attributable executed result per required semantic distinction.
acceptance.when: The Replay Matrix is executed or evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the RMAP-R6-S2 replay-matrix assertion after removing any one required semantic case from stable-candidate-replay-matrix.v1.json; the runtime assertion must fail because the executed result set is incomplete.

Run the RMAP-R6-S2 replay-matrix assertion after replacing a required semantic case with an out-of-set or relabeled case; the runtime assertion must fail because the closed six-distinction set is not preserved.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make replay-matrix evaluate the repository's closed Matrix Case set as exactly the six required semantic distinctions and emit attributable executed results only when each required distinction is present once; reject omission, substitution, duplication, or relabeling as aggregate failure.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing repository-relative v2 matrix and replay receipt contract; an invalid closed-set composition must produce an unsuccessful aggregate rather than reinterpret a missing required distinction as success.

slice_hint.state_transition: The Matrix Case set changes from not completely exercised to completely exercised only after the replay receipt proves one execution for every member of the frozen closed six-distinction set.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The replay-matrix receipt is successful and its executed case results map one-to-one to valid package, invalid package, historical compatibility, dirty baseline, knowledge read-set collision, and closed-policy architecture-index gap, with no missing, substituted, duplicate, or relabeled required distinction.
